comments.author: @UnseenWorldDocs_Us
comments.text:
Would you live in a village where no men are allowed? In this Kenya documentary, we visit a village in the dry north run entirely by women, then follow 2 million animals toward a river full of crocodiles. What these women built there, and why, may surprise you.
👇 Your pick: the women-only village, or the Great Migration? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe for the next journey.
#Kenya #KenyaDocumentary #TravelAfrica
